criteria.commensurate: No. Seed 4 at 10hh: web 0.87 -> 1.14 s, roll 3.4 -> 3.7 s (+9%; the pair +12.1%), and web +0.11 to +0.35 s on every 40hh seed, all for off-canvas connector that no drawn map shows. The visible gain (a track that reaches the frame) costs nothing extra when drawn only to the edge.
criteria.necessary: The NEED is real, the cost is not: wave 46 drew the track out taut (0081) and a fixed 4,000 ft fell short of a 5,600 ft canvas's far edge, so the track must leave the frame on every bearing. Drawing it the canvas' whole diagonal is not needed for that - the length past the edge is cropped away, yet field_runs samples all of it (run_on_target 3,577 -> 5,481 calls on seed 4).
criteria.no_way_around: There is a way around it, already written: past_the_frame (canvas edge on its bearing + 400 ft, commit 66a73e2f2). Applied ALONE to 2e3153b4e it puts web back to 0.92 / 0.71 / 2.04 s (seed 4 at 10 / 15 / 40hh) against start 0.87 / 0.72 / 1.99 and end 1.14 / 0.83 / 2.34. So the slowdown at the measured end commit was avoidable.
